wellbeing.headline: Wellbeing-focused synthesis
wellbeing.emphasis: The analysis is anchored on symptoms, physiology, medication-herb safety, nutrition, and recovery patterns.
questions: What is changing most in your body or daily function?
Have you started any new medicines, herbs, supplements, or fasting patterns?
What is making symptoms worse or better?

peace.headline: Peace-focused synthesis
peace.emphasis: The review emphasizes stress, emotional regulation, sleep disruption, conflict patterns, and safety.
questions: What feels most destabilizing right now?
What support or routine helps you feel more grounded?
What pattern is draining your sense of calm or safety?

power.headline: Power-focused synthesis
power.emphasis: This lens prioritizes personal agency, decision fatigue, boundaries, momentum, and practical action.
questions: Where do you feel least able to act or choose?
What is draining your energy or confidence?
What one decision would improve your agency this week?

money.headline: Money-focused synthesis
money.emphasis: This review centers financial pressure, obligations, cash flow, planning, and the next workable step.
questions: What is creating the most pressure right now?
What bills, commitments, or burdens feel most urgent?
What would reduce your stress within the next 30 days?

career.headline: Money & business reflection synthesis
career.emphasis: The plan emphasizes work fit, direction, burnout, skill-building, and sustainable professional decisions.
questions: What part of work or study feels least aligned?
Where are you stuck between exploration and action?
What would make the path more sustainable and clear?

relationships.headline: Relationships & family synthesis
relationships.emphasis: This lens prioritizes communication, safety, boundaries, family roles, and conflict patterns with trauma-aware framing.
questions: What pattern is repeating in the relationship or family dynamic?
Where do you feel safest or least safe?
What would help the communication feel more steady and fair?

spiritual.headline: Spiritual & life direction synthesis
spiritual.emphasis: This lens emphasizes purpose, life direction, ritual meaning, and reflective guidance while keeping mental-wellbeing safety distinct.
questions: What area of life feels most unclear or spiritually heavy right now?
What traditions or questions feel most meaningful to you?
What would help you feel more grounded in purpose?

legal.headline: Peace & harmony synthesis
legal.emphasis: This review focuses on safety, communication, and options for peaceful resolution without replacing formal legal advice.
questions: What conflict or relationship strain would you like help navigating?
Is anyone in immediate danger or at risk of harm?
What would a safer, more peaceful next step look like?

social.headline: Social-focused synthesis
social.emphasis: This lens prioritizes family ties, belonging, support networks, boundaries, and relationship dynamics.
questions: Who feels supportive and who contributes to strain?
What connection feels missing or difficult?
What would make you feel more seen, included, or safe?
